div.div:
The slot contract
1. Pure. Item and Background render twice (card + shell). Same props → same pixels, or a ghost shows at hand-off. No internal state, no enter/press animations of their own.
2. Don't animate size or position inside a slot. Read progress / hovered (SharedValues) for opacity, color, rotation.
3. Known heights: layout.rowHeight or a pure itemHeight().
4. Opaque Background: card and shell swap in one frame.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 562px; height: 1px; padding-top: 595px; margin-left: 770px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Outside the card
Scrim — behind the open menu (opacity animated for you; tap closes)
Backdrop — behind the full screen
MorphCloseButton — in your screens; icon via closeIcon / icon
fabIcon · item.icon — any MorphIcon: element, image source or ({ size, color }) => node
Beyond slots: useMorphProgress() → { menu, sheet } to drive your own animations.
